statements.quote: Record Data Center segment revenue of $2.3 billion was up 80% year-over-year driven by growth in both AMD Instinct™ GPUs and 4 th Gen AMD EPYC™ CPUs.
statements.notes: Quarterly figure (Q1 fiscal 2024, three months ended 2024-03-30), not full-year. Data Center segment revenue includes server CPUs as well as AI accelerators. The segment table in p08 gives $2,337 million.

statements.quote: Record data center GPU sales with MI300 surpassing $1B in cumulative sales since Q4’23 launch
statements.notes: Slide bullet, not a full sentence. 'Surpassing' makes $1B a lower bound. The figure is cumulative across Q4 fiscal 2023 and Q1 fiscal 2024, so it is not attributable to fiscal 2024 alone.

none_found.reason: Capital expenditures of $142 million appear only in tables (p07, p08), and no sentence links capital expenditures to AI.
No sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses to AI. The CFO's 'investing in the large AI opportunities ahead' (p02) does not name capex, opex or R&D.
